caveat: Features and prices are first-party public-page snapshots, not audited product tests. Strategic observations are Holdem Lab inferences and must be rechecked before pricing or positioning decisions.

Education-only heads-up PokerArena with virtual currency

direct_competitors.real_money_relationship: The site states that the study platform and PokerArena do not offer real-money gambling. It also markets a separate table tool with layouts, overlays, and automatic history upload, so Holdem Lab should keep a clearer no-table-software boundary.

Unified study, practice, and analysis workflow
Strong integrity messaging and Fair Play Check

A simpler explanation-first path can serve learners who are not ready to configure ranges and trees.
Integrity should be a visible product feature, not only a legal footnote.

learning_analogues.name: Anki
mechanics: Active recall before revealing the answer
Review intervals that respond to recall difficulty
A due queue instead of an endless content feed
product_lessons: Schedule concepts and error patterns, not exact card deals alone.
Let users distinguish forgotten, difficult, and easy recalls.
Keep the scheduling algorithm versioned and explainable.
avoid_copying: Reducing multi-step poker judgment to fact flashcards
Overloading new learners with an unbounded review backlog

learning_analogues.name: Chessable MoveTrainer
mechanics: Courses combine explanations with trainable decisions
product_lessons: A lesson should compile into trainable decision points.
Users can build a personal repertoire without changing the canonical course.
Expert content and the practice engine can be separate assets joined by a stable schema.
avoid_copying: Treating poker as memorizing one forced move
Rewarding review volume without measuring transfer to new situations

learning_analogues.name: Brilliant
mechanics: Learn by solving rather than watching
Personalized paths from foundations to advanced topics
product_lessons: Teach pot odds, ranges, and board texture through manipulable examples.
Use a sequence of small insights before a full-hand decision.
Make mistakes productive by explaining the misconception.
avoid_copying: Quoting marketing efficacy numbers as proof for Holdem Lab
Turning every topic into decorative animation instead of a real decision

learning_analogues.name: Lichess Puzzles and Studies
mechanics: Puzzles adapted by rating and selectable themes
Studies that combine positions, annotations, variations, and interactive lessons
product_lessons: Build a free public practice commons around stable themes.
Offer retry and analysis after commitment.
Keep public study content linkable and remixable only when rights allow.
avoid_copying: Using one opaque rating as the only learning model
Assuming a best-move puzzle maps cleanly to mixed-frequency poker decisions
